subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently replace the standalone Talk destination with Chat-owned realtime voice controls and route the existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases to Chat?
rationale: This is a user-facing navigation and upgrade contract, not a mechanical bug fix: code review can verify the implementation, but only maintainers can choose the product’s permanent conversational model.

options.title: Sponsor unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the single conversational surface, including the removed Talk tab and alias redirects, then land the branch after current-head checks.

options.title: Keep a separate Talk destination
options.body: Retain the existing tab-level product split and close or substantially narrow this proposal rather than merging an incompatible navigation change.

options.title: Split the lifecycle work
options.body: Extract only session-safety and ownership hardening while deferring the permanent navigation redesign to a maintainer-owned proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single conversational surface, including the removed Talk tab and alias redirects, then land the branch after current-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review specifically routed the unresolved product decision here; confidence remains low because local feature-history commands could not run.
